dialect.detail: IBM mainframe COBOL; uses RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, LABEL RECORDS ARE STANDARD, COMP-3, COMP, ILBOABN0 abend routine, and fixed-format source with sequence numbers. Version tracking comments (e.g. 02.38, 03.66) suggest a long-lived production system. COPY statements reference IBM-style copybooks (KMCADDFO, FDFEICF, FDFEPKG, KMCCRATE, etc.).

purpose.domain_detail: Bankcard/merchant transaction processing — preliminary edit and validation of merchant transactions including interchange rate handling, EBT, passthrough, downgrade, reconciliation, and settlement
purpose.summary: BAC00110 is a large batch program that performs preliminary editing and validation of bankcard merchant transactions. It handles multiple transaction codes (2000, 3000, 3100, 0601-0607, 0701-0707, etc.), applies interchange rate lookups, check-digit validation, plan assignment, reconciliation, and produces multiple report and output files. It calls numerous subprograms for specific validation and processing tasks.

notable_features: Indexed file access (FEICF, FEPKG) with FILE STATUS
192 CALLs to subprograms (BASCKDGT, BACONDEC, DATECONV, BAS10001, BAS110AR, BASCRATE, etc.)
1019 PERFORMs and 539 GOTOs indicating complex procedural logic
Multiple report output files (passthru, downgrade, PBD-EBT, reject, default)
verdict.notes: File is 1.5MB / 26K lines — only first 16K characters were shown. Program-ID BAC00110 with author PLANET CONSULTING. Version annotation '03.66' in INVENTORY-LEVEL field suggests a mature, versioned production system. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS found; purely batch. The ILBOABN0 call is an IBM OS/VS COBOL abend routine, strongly confirming IBM mainframe heritage.
